purpose: Bind one red test per criterion of US-19005 (FBS-230), each driving bin/rcf.js over fixture git repositories with a bare local remote and servers on 127.0.0.1, so the Build hand makes them green against the pre-merge Finalise rule of ADR-4151.
title: Pre-merge Finalise and loopback targets: rcf build finalise promotes on the PR branch, accepts a loopback report naming engine, port and served sha, refuses an uncommitted report, keeps provenance, confirms on main after a merge commit, keeps --allow-pre-merge as a no-op; rcf verify run records the loopback fields; the shipped text says so

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on a feature or hotfix branch whose HEAD contains the report head exits 0 with no flag, writes verified on the branch, prints the verified-from line, no off-trunk refusal, no C-26 line, spawns nothing but git
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-1: on a branch other than main or master whose HEAD contains the report head, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> exits 0 with no flag, writes verified on the branch and prints the verified-from line, with no "not a default trunk" refusal, no claim C-26 line and nothing but git spawned

testCases.description: a committed loopback report (each loopback form) naming target.engine, target.port and target.servedSha equal to headSha promotes: exit 0, verified, no "is loopback"
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-2: a committed VerifyReport with a loopback target naming target.engine, target.port and target.servedSha equal to its headSha, hand verifier, PASS with ship authority, promotes: exit 0, verified, the verified-from line, no "is loopback"

testCases.description: a committed loopback report lacking engine, port or servedSha exits 4 with "finalise refused: loopback report target <url> names no target.<field>", FBS byte-identical; guard: a non-loopback report needs none
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-3: a committed loopback VerifyReport lacking target.engine, target.port or target.servedSha refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: loopback report target <url> names no target.<field>" (first missing in the order engine, port, servedSha), the FBS byte-identical

testCases.description: a committed loopback report whose target.servedSha is not its headSha exits 4 with "finalise refused: report target.servedSha <sha7> is not the report head <sha7>", FBS byte-identical
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-4: a committed loopback VerifyReport naming target.engine and target.port whose target.servedSha is not its headSha refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: report target.servedSha <served sha7> is not the report head <head sha7>", the FBS byte-identical

testCases.description: rcf verify run --hand verifier --url <loopback> --engine <name> --served-sha <HEAD> records target { kind, url, engine, port, servedSha }
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: rcf verify run --hand verifier --url <loopback-url> --engine <name> --served-sha <committed HEAD> records target { kind "url", url, engine, port, servedSha } in rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<head12>.json

testCases.description: rcf verify run --served-sha other than the full committed HEAD exits 4 with "verify report refused: --served-sha <value> is not the committed HEAD <sha7>", no report, no probe
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: a --served-sha that is not the full sha of the committed HEAD exits 4 with "verify report refused: --served-sha <value> is not the committed HEAD <sha7>", writing no report and sending no probe

testCases.description: rcf verify run --hand with a loopback --url and no --engine or no --served-sha exits 2 naming the flag, no report, no probe
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: a loopback --url with --hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --engine <name> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --engine, and "[error] usage --served-sha <sha> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --served-sha, writing no report and sending no probe

testCases.description: a report not committed in HEAD (newest on disk or --report) or differing from its committed bytes exits 4 with the named message, FBS byte-identical; guard: the committed report promotes
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-6: a report on disk but not committed in HEAD refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: verify report <path> is not committed at HEAD", and a committed report whose bytes on disk differ refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: verify report <path> differs from its committed bytes at HEAD", the FBS byte-identical

testCases.description: on a branch, a builder Hand-Id equal to verifierId, an over-age report and an uncontained head each exit 4 with their message ("re-verify this head"), FBS byte-identical, nothing but git spawned
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-7: on a branch other than main or master Finalise keeps provenance: a builder Hand-Id equal to verifierId, a report older than --max-report-age and a report head not contained in HEAD each exit 4 with their message, the FBS byte-identical and nothing but git spawned

testCases.description: verified on the branch, merged with --no-ff, rcf build finalise on main confirms: exit 0, verified-from line, FBS byte-identical, clean tree, nothing but git spawned
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-8: after Finalise writes verified on the branch and the branch merges into main with --no-ff, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on main confirms: exit 0, the verified-from line, the FBS byte-identical, a clean tree, nothing but git spawned

testCases.description: rcf build finalise with --allow-pre-merge gives the same exit, write and refusal as without it, one deprecation line, no C-26 output
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-9: --allow-pre-merge is accepted and changes nothing: the same exit, write and refusal as without it, exactly one deprecation line on stderr, and no output naming claim C-26 or "records the pre-merge decision"

testCases.description: finalise HELP, build HELP, guidance build-cycle, playbook sections 6 and 7, the managed block and the bundle runbook Stage 5 say "on the PR branch before the merge" and name loopback with a served sha; none carries an after-the-merge Finalise shape
testCases.testPointer: test/guidance/premerge-finalise-text.test.js::AC-19005-10: rcf build finalise --help, rcf build --help, rcf guidance build-cycle, the playbook (sections 6 and 7), the managed block and the bundle runbook Stage 5 say "on the PR branch before the merge" and name loopback targets with a served sha, and none says "the CI run that passed on the merged head" or puts mark complete or finalise after the merge

testCases.description: End to end: a real rcf verify run --hand verifier against a server on 127.0.0.1 with --engine and --served-sha HEAD writes the loopback report; committed on the feature branch, rcf build finalise on that branch promotes
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-1, AC-19005-2 and AC-19005-5 (end to end): a real rcf verify run --hand verifier --url http://127.0.0.1:<port> --engine --served-sha HEAD writes a loopback report naming engine, port and served sha; committed on the feature branch, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on that branch promotes it to verified

testCases.description: End to end: the loopback report verified on the feature branch, merged with --no-ff, confirms on main with exit 0 and no write
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/premerge-loopback-finalise.test.js::AC-19005-8 (end to end): the loopback report verified on the feature branch, merged into main with --no-ff, confirms on main with exit 0 and no write

testCases.description: rcf verify run refuses --engine and --served-sha whenever the target is not a --url (a directory, a tarball or a name@version: --artefact <tgz>, --package <dir>, --package <tarball file>, --package <name@version>) with a usage error, exit 2, naming the flag, with or without --hand, before any pack, install or engine call, writing no report
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/loopback-target-run.test.js::AC-19005-5: whenever the target is not a --url (a directory, a tarball or a name@version) --engine and --served-sha each exit 2 with "[error] usage --engine applies only to a --url target; a non-URL target (directory, tarball or name@version) has no served URL" (and the same for --served-sha), with or without --hand, before any pack, install or engine call, writing no report
